title: Sequential fractionation and isolation of subcellular proteins from tissue or cultured cells
author: Baghirova, Hughes, et al.

steps.title: Mince and wash tissue
steps.instruction: Mince fresh, unfrozen tissue into 2–4 mm pieces and wash with 1 mL ice‑cold PBS (10 mM Na₂HPO₄, 2 mM KH₂PO₄, 137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, pH 7.4).

steps.title: Transfer tissue to tube
steps.instruction: Add 40–60 mg of the minced tissue to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer A
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer A and 5 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail to the tube.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Disrupt the tissue for 5 seconds with a handheld rotor‑stator homogenizer.

steps.title: Filter homogenate
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a Qiashredder column (Qiagen 79656) and centrifuge at 500 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover filtrate
steps.instruction: Discard the top filter containing trapped particles, then gently pipette the pellet up and down in the filtrate to resuspend it; transfer the suspension to a new tube.

steps.title: Second lysis with buffer A
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer A (use 1.5 mL if processing brain tissue) plus 5 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail, then incubate on an end‑over‑end rotator for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge for cytosol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (cytosolic fraction).

steps.title: Lysis with buffer B
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer B with 10 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail, incubate on an end‑over‑end rotator for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge for membrane fraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (membrane‑bound organelle fraction).

steps.title: Prepare benzonase solution
steps.instruction: Add 500 units benzonase (Sigma E1014) to 20 µL water; combine this solution with the pellet from the previous step.

steps.title: Benzonase digestion
steps.instruction: Gently flick the tube to resuspend the pellet and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Lysis with buffer C
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer C plus 5 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail to the benzonase‑treated pellet, incubate on an end‑over‑end rotator for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge for nuclear fraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6 800 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (nuclear proteins).

steps.title: Optional solubilization of resistant pellet
steps.instruction: The remaining pellet (nuclear proteins resistant to extraction) can be solubilized with lysis buffer C supplemented with 8 M urea or discarded.

steps.title: Wash cultured cells
steps.instruction: Remove culture medium from a 100 mm dish and wash the cells with room‑temperature PBS.

steps.title: Trypsinize cells
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL 0.25 % trypsin : 0.9 mM EDTA : phenol red solution (Gibco 25200) and incubate at 37 °C for 2 min or until cells detach.

steps.title: Neutralize trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL culture medium containing 10 % fetal bovine serum, then collect the cells.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse cell pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 500 µL ice‑cold PBS using a 1 mL pipette, then centrifuge again at 500 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lysis with buffer A (cells)
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 400 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer A plus 4 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail, and incubate on an end‑over‑end rotator for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge for cytosol (cells)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (cytosolic proteins).

steps.title: Lysis with buffer B (cells)
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer B plus 4 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail, resuspend the pellet by vortexing, and incubate on ice (or 4 °C) for 30 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge for membrane fraction (cells)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (membrane‑bound organelle proteins).

steps.title: Lysis with buffer C (cells)
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer C containing 7 µL benzonase (Sigma) and 4 µL protease‑inhibitor cocktail, then incubate on an end‑over‑end rotator for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge for nuclear fraction (cells)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 800 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant (nuclear proteins).

steps.title: Optional solubilization of resistant pellet (cells)
steps.instruction: The remaining pellet (nuclear proteins resistant to extraction) can be solubilized with lysis buffer C supplemented with 8 M urea or discarded.
